title: Deception Standard and Advanced plans: decoy counts, Gen AI decoys, orchestration and API access

prose.text: Deception has two plans, Standard and Advanced, and the limits are per organization. {{plan-rules}} {{bundle-minimum}}

checks.do: Which plan the tenant has before answering whether Gen AI decoys, custom orchestration rules, SIEM forwarding, Private Access containment or API access are available.
For a Deception entitlement that came with a ZIA or ZPA edition, whether the subscription has at least 1,000 users.

plan-rules.statement: All values are per organization unless noted; raising limits or upgrading from Standard to Advanced goes through the account team or Zscaler Support, and after a plan switch only the active plan's features remain enabled.

quotes: All values are per organization unless noted otherwise.
If you need to increase maximum limits or upgrade the plan from Deception Standard to Deception Advanced, contact your Zscaler Account team or send a request to Zscaler Support.
If you switch plans, then you can use only the features that are available in the active plan. Any additional features that are not a part of the active plan are disabled.

bundle-minimum.statement: A Deception Standard or Advanced plan included with a ZIA or ZPA edition can be claimed only with a minimum of 1,000 users in the subscription.

quotes: If you subscribed to a Internet & SaaS (ZIA) or Private Access (ZPA) edition that includes a Deception Standard or Deception Advanced plan, you must have a minimum of 1,000 users in your subscription to be eligible to claim your Deception entitlement.

decoy-limits.statement: Standard includes 20 decoys and Advanced 300; Windows high-interaction virtual machine decoys, high-interaction container decoys and Gen AI decoys are Advanced only.

quotes: | Decoys | 20 | 300 |
| Windows High-Interaction Virtual Machine Decoys | Not supported | Supported |
| High-Interaction Container Decoys | Not supported | Supported |
| Gen AI Decoys | Not supported | Supported |

decoy-count-composition.statement: The plan's decoy count is the sum of Threat Intelligence, network, cloud (Azure and AWS) and Active Directory decoys; landmine decoys are counted separately, daily, as the sum of Client Connector, standalone and agentless landmine decoys.

quotes: The number of decoys included in your Zscaler Deception plan is the sum of Threat Intelligence (TI) Decoys, Network Decoys, Cloud Decoys (Azure Decoys and AWS Decoys), and Active Directory Decoys.

For licensing purposes, the total number of active landmine decoys is computed every day and is equal to the sum of Zscaler Client Connector landmine decoys, standalone landmine decoys, and agentless landmine decoys.

connectors-equal-decoys.statement: The number of Decoy Connectors equals the number of decoys in the license, subject to system limitations.

quotes: The total number of Decoy Connectors is equal to the number of decoys included in your Deception license.
System limitations are applicable.

decoy-caps.statement: At most 10 network decoys can have custom services enabled, and at most 5 high-interaction containers are allowed per license.

quotes: The number of network decoys with custom services enabled is limited to 10.
A maximum of 5 high-interaction containers is allowed per license.

orchestrate.statement: Standard supports built-in orchestration rules only; custom rules, enrichment, SIEM forwarding, containment, Zscaler Sandbox, managed threat hunting and Private Access containment integrations are Advanced only; email notifications are limited to 500 per day.

quotes: | Orchestration Rules | Built-in rules supported | Built-in and custom rules supported |
| Enrichment Integration | Not supported | Supported |
| SIEM Forwarding | Not supported | Supported |
| Containment Integration | Not supported | Supported |
| Zscaler Sandbox Integration | Not supported | Supported |
| Managed Threat Hunting Integration | Not supported | Supported |
| Private Access Containment | Not supported | Supported |
Deception limits the number of email notifications triggered to 500 emails per day.

enterprise.statement: In the Enterprise settings table, single sign-on and audit logs are supported on both plans; API access is not supported on the Standard Plan and supported on the Advanced Plan; custom roles are listed only in the Advanced Plan column (Standard lists predefined only).

evidence.after: The following table shows the ranges and limitations for the Enterprise settings.
quotes: | Feature | Standard Plan | Advanced Plan |
| Single Sign-On | Supported | Supported |
| Roles | Predefined rules supported | Predefined and custom roles supported |
| API Access | Not supported | Supported |
| Audit Logs | Supported | Supported |
